shots.prompt: A rugged ancient Thracian warrior in fur and leather sits by a fire at dawn in misty Balkan mountains, a clay pot of yogurt beside him, breath visible in cold air. Epic, mythic, cinematic, photorealistic.

EPIC WIDE LOW-ANGLE. The Thracian warrior stands on a mountain peak at golden sunrise holding the clay pot high, sweeping misty Balkan range behind, the birth of a legend. Cinematic epic mythic mood, photorealistic.
